hm_hero_sub: One extension and web workbench for public creator research, single and batch downloads, speech-to-text, bilingual captions, AI scripts, summaries and campaign planning.
hm_trust: Chrome extension + web workbench · Public creator data · Authorized media only
hm_feat_dl_b: Search public creators, browse category rankings with advanced filters, and save shortlists for your research
hm_feat_cap_b: AI transcription builds bilingual captions; translate the comment section into your language in one click
hm_feat_data_b: Analyze public creator signals — followers, views, engagement and content patterns — then export a clean research file
hm_feat_ai_b: Turn videos into transcripts, bilingual captions, structured scripts, summaries, rewrites and creative briefs
hm_rv1_q: Pulled a shortlist of 40 creators for a competitor teardown in one coffee break. The rankings and filters actually match how we brief campaigns.
hm_rv2_q: The bilingual subtitles are the killer feature for me. I read comment sections in three languages now without ever leaving TikTok.
hm_rv3_q: I manage 30+ creator collabs a month. The outreach funnel and collection folders replaced two spreadsheets and a prayer.
hm_rv4_q: Script analysis feels like having a strategist on call. Paste a viral video, get the hook structure back in seconds.
hm_rv5_q: Follower counts, GPM, sales estimates — right on the profile while I browse. This is how creator vetting should work.
hm_rv6_q: Set it up for our whole growth team in an afternoon. The web workbench syncing with the extension is genuinely slick.
hm_rv7_q: I was skeptical about yet another TikTok tool. Then the AI comment digest saved me from signing a bad influencer deal.
hm_rv8_q: The marketing calendar with regional sale days — 9.9, 11.11, Ramadan — quietly became the page I check every Monday.

seo_desc_home: Search and analyze TikTok creators, download videos without watermark, generate AI scripts and hashtags — all in one Chrome extension and web workbench.
seo_desc_price: Compare free and paid plans with monthly credits for TikTok video downloads, creator search, AI scripts and data export. Start free, upgrade anytime.
seo_desc_download: Paste a TikTok link to download HD video without watermark, or save the MP3 audio. Free, no sign-in, nothing stored; the extension adds batch download.
seo_desc_script: Turn any TikTok video into a structured script with AI: hook, selling points and CTA at a glance. Analyze viral videos and draft promo copy in minutes.
seo_desc_hashtag: Find high-frequency TikTok hashtags collected from real video data. Filter by keyword, copy tags in one click and boost the reach of your next post.
seo_desc_nettest: Can't open TikTok? Check in seconds whether your network can reach tiktok.com, then follow simple tips on regional restrictions and proxy settings.
seo_desc_guide: Install the Chrome or Edge extension, sign in, browse TikTok and work on the web: a step-by-step guide to video downloads, creator analytics, AI scripts and FAQs.
seo_desc_kol_search: Search TikTok influencers by keyword or ID, filter by country, followers and engagement rate, then browse rankings and save shortlists for your campaigns.
nf_body: The page you're looking for doesn't exist or has moved.
seo_desc_rank_kol: TikTok influencer rankings by followers, 30-day follower growth, average views and engagement rate, computed in real time from extension data.
seo_desc_rank_video: TikTok video rankings sorted by views and likes. Browse trending videos, spot viral content early and study what makes top-performing posts work.
seo_desc_rank_product: TikTok product rankings by units sold. Discover trending TikTok Shop products, compare sales performance and pick items worth promoting.
hm_gallery_sub: Explore the extension and web workbench across creator research, downloads, transcripts, AI briefs, planning and export. Select any frame to expand.
